ideas.title: Point a Custom Domain at Cloudflare Pages Without Leaving the Site on the Default Subdomain
ideas.description: Cloudflare Pages stays on the generated pages.dev hostname until DNS and the Pages custom domain are configured together.
ideas.angle: Describe how Cloudflare Pages binds hostnames and why DNS alone does not attach a custom domain to a project. Explain the required steps in Pages and the DNS record setup, including apex and www handling, so the reader can verify the hostname, certificate, and route are all aligned.

ideas.title: React Native Fails to Bundle When a Shared Module Imports Node Built-ins
ideas.description: Metro stops bundling when shared code pulls in fs, path, or crypto that the React Native runtime cannot provide.
ideas.angle: Explain why React Native’s runtime and Metro resolver do not include Node built-ins, even when a dependency works on web or Node. Cover how to spot the offending import, how transitive dependencies trigger the failure, and how to replace or shim the code with platform-specific modules.

ideas.title: Next.js App Router Serves Stale Data Because a Server Component Fetch Is Cached
ideas.description: Next.js can reuse a server component fetch result unless you set the right cache mode or revalidation behavior.
ideas.angle: Explain how the App Router caches fetch calls in server components by default and why that can return old data. Cover request memoization, static rendering, revalidate, and cache: 'no-store', then show how to choose the right option for per-request freshness or controlled regeneration.

ideas.title: Vite Resolves the Wrong Package in a pnpm Workspace Because tsconfig Paths Leak Into Build Imports
ideas.description: A pnpm monorepo can resolve a local source file instead of the published package entry point and break the build.
ideas.angle: Explain how path aliases and workspace links can bypass the package entry point that bundlers expect. Cover why the build resolves differently from TypeScript, how that affects exports, and how to fix it with package.json exports, Vite alias rules, or narrower tsconfig paths.

drafted.title: SvelteKit Throws ReferenceError: document is not defined During Server-Side Rendering
drafted.description: SvelteKit SSR crashes when a component touches document before the browser runs it; isolate browser-only code and gate it behind client checks.
drafted.angle: Explain that SvelteKit renders components on the server first, so any top-level reference to document fails before hydration. Cover the mechanisms that trigger it, such as module initialization, load functions, and shared utilities, then show the correct fixes: onMount, browser guards, and moving DOM access into client-only code.
